title: Yellow Creamy Greek Cox Apple Tiropita
description: A creamy and savory Greek dish featuring Cox apples, simmered to perfection and wrapped in a flaky tiropita crust, served on a salt block.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, simmer the sliced Cox apples over medium heat until they are tender.
In a large bowl, mix together the crumbly feta cheese, softened yellow cream cheese, and beaten eggs.
Add the cooked Cox apples to the cheese mixture and stir until well combined.
Unroll the phyllo dough and cut it into 4 equal pieces.
Place a quarter of the cheese and apple mixture onto the center of each phyllo piece.
Fold the phyllo into a triangle and brush the edges with melted butter.
Place the tiropita on a preheated salt block and bake for 25 minutes.
Remove the tiropita from the oven and let it cool for 5 minutes before serving.
